items.source: A registry of currently connected users.
items.translation: 当前已连接用户的注册表。

items.source:
A strategy for resolving a "user" destination by translating it to one or more
actual destinations one per active user session.
items.translation: 一种通过将“用户”目的地解析为每个活动用户会话对应一个实际目的地的策略。

items.source: Represents a subscription within a user session.
items.translation: 表示用户会话中的订阅。

items.source: SimpUserRegistry that looks up users in a "local" user registry as well as a set of "remote" user registries.
items.translation: SimpUserRegistry 用于在“本地”用户注册表以及一组“远程”用户注册表中查找用户。

items.source: Configuration support for WebSocket messaging using higher level messaging protocols.

items.translation: Spring 消息模块的 WebSocket 集成。

Contains the result from parsing a "user" destination from a source message
and translating it to target destinations (one per active user session).
